title: Capacity Allocation Validator
description: Sums assignments by named resource and compares each total with its explicit capacity. It reports over-allocation evidence without rebalancing work.
decision: The result is overallocated when any resource total exceeds its capacity. Otherwise it is within_capacity and reports remaining capacity for every resource.
inputs: The caller supplies a resource-to-capacity map and assignments with unique IDs, exact resource names, and nonnegative finite amounts. Resource names are case-sensitive and unknown references are rejected.
limitations: This arithmetic check cannot assess skill fit, scheduling conflicts, time zones, concurrency, or whether capacity estimates are realistic. It does not move, reject, or approve assignments.
